title: Reverse micellar extraction of recombinant cold-adapted AMS8 lipase
author: Fatin Nurfauziana
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.krscv6e
materials: Preparation of recombinant cold-adapted lipase AMS8
Estimation of activity recovery and purification fold
Protein sequence and predicted model of lipAMS8
Open YASARA Structure (version 11.3.22, Krieger) software and load PDB file of your enzyme
-Forcefield: AMBER03 with the cut off 10.846 Å
Choose Edit and clean all the molecules
Then, save the scene as [your title.sce] format
Start run MD simulation for 10 ns

steps.title: Initial Culture Activation
steps.instruction: Activate the E. coli BL21 (DE3) containing pET32b/AMS8 plasmid from storage.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve stock from 80% (v/v) glycerol at -80 °C.
Streak culture on LB agar with ampicillin and incubate at 37 °C for 12 h.
Select one colony and grow in LB broth with ampicillin (50 µg/ml) at 37 °C for 16-18 h, shaking at 200 rpm.

steps.title: Confirm Lipase Production
steps.instruction: Verify the production of recombinant AMS8 lipase using Tributyrin agar.

substeps.instruction: Streak recombinant AMS8 lipase on Tributyrin LB agar plates containing ampicillin.
Incubate plates at 37 °C overnight.
Transfer plates to 4 °C for 1-3 days.

steps.title: Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Express the recombinant lipase in liquid culture.

substeps.instruction: Grow a single colony in 50 ml LB broth containing ampicillin (50 µg/ml).
Add 100 mM IPTG and incubate for 16-18 h.

steps.title: Cell Harvest and Lysis
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and release the soluble protein.

substeps.instruction: Harvest bacterial cells into 50 ml falcon tubes and centrifuge at 6654 x g, 4 °C, for 30 min.
Resuspend cell pellets in 50 mM sodium phosphate, 100 mM NaCl, pH 7.
Sonicate for 6 min (using 30s off intervals).

steps.title: Separation of Soluble and Insoluble Lipase
steps.instruction: Separate the soluble fraction from the insoluble pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the cell suspension at 6654 x g, 4 °C, for 30 min to separate the supernatant (soluble lipase) and pellet (insoluble lipase).

steps.title: Solubilization and Refolding of Insoluble Lipase
steps.instruction: Solubilize the pellet and refold the protein.

substeps.instruction: Treat the collected pellet with 8 M urea, 100 mM NaCl, and 10 mM CaCl2 at 4 °C for 1.5 h.
Centrifuge the sample at 6654 x g, 4 °C, for 30 min.
Refold the protein by titrating 50 mM sodium phosphate buffer, 100 mM NaCl, pH 7 into the sample at a flow rate of 2 ml/min.

steps.title: Reverse Micellar Extraction (RME)
steps.instruction: Perform forward and backward extraction using reverse micelles.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the organic phase using Triton X-100 in toluene at various concentrations.
Forward Extraction: Inject 10 ml of refolded AMS8 lipase into the organic phase (volume ratio 1:1).
Centrifuge for phase separation at 3000 rpm, 20 °C, for 30 min.
Backward Extraction: Inject stripping solution (50 mM Tris-Cl, 1 M KCl, pH 9) into the resulting emulsion and stir at 601 x g, 20 °C, for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 3607 x g, 20 °C, for 45 min.

steps.title: Lipase Activity Assay
steps.instruction: Measure the activity of the lipase extract.

substeps.instruction: Dropwise add 400 µl of 23.96 M pNPP solution into 3 ml of buffer solution (0.05 M sodium phosphate pH 7, 0.1 g Arabic gum, and 0.4 g Triton X-100) under stirring.
Add 50 µl of lipase extract to the mixture and incubate at 20 °C for 5 min.
Add 10% (w/v) SDS solution to demulsify the reaction mixture (for organic phase).

steps.title: Protein Content Estimation
steps.instruction: Quantify protein using the Folin-Ciocalteu method.

substeps.instruction: Plot a BSA standard curve in the range 0-2000 µg of protein.
Add 1 ml of sample to 5 ml of alkaline copper reagent and vortex shortly.
After 10 min, add 0.5 ml of 1 N Folin-Ciocalteu reagent and let stand for at least 20 min for detergent precipitation.
Centrifuge at 1202 x g for 10 min.
Read absorbance at 700 nm against a reagent blank.

steps.title: SDS-PAGE Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze protein purity and molecular weight via electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Precipitate the sample from the aqueous phase using 10% trichloroacetic acid (TCA).
Prepare acrylamide gel: 12% (v/v) resolving gel and 4% (v/v) stacking gel.
Mix 8 µl of lipase extract with 2 µl sample buffer and load into the gel.
Run in a Criterion Vertical Electrophoresis Cell at 210 V and 60 mA for 1 h.
Stain the gel for 5 min and destain using a buffer of 0.05% (v/v) Coomassie Brilliant Blue G-250, 30% (v/v) methanol, and 10% (v/v) acetic acid.
Compare against a Fermentas protein marker standard (116.0 to 14.4 kDa).

steps.title: Molecular Dynamics (MD) Simulation
steps.instruction: Perform computational simulation of the AMS8 lipase model.

substeps.instruction: Use the predicted model of AMS8 lipase (based on P. fluorescens strain AMS8, superimposing S. marcescens and Pseudomonas sp. MIS38 structures) with calcium and zinc ions intact.
Insert simulation box (all around atoms).
Load 100 molecules of Triton X-100 into the box (sdf file).
Load toluene molecules into the box, setting densities according to temperature.
Set temperature to 25 °C (298.15 K) or other desired temperatures.
Fix the enzyme position for energy minimization.
Set the enzyme to free position after energy minimization is complete.
Analyze enzyme stability and flexibility using root mean square deviation (RMSd) and root mean square fluctuation (RMSf).
Align protein simulation snapshots in Triton X-100/toluene reverse micelles parallel arrangement using PyMOL.
